sections.1_problem: Implantable devices (sensors, valves, drug-delivery actuators) need power for years without percutaneous leads or repeated battery-revision surgery; battery volume dominates device size and revision risk. The frozen dossier targets the implanted-shunt power problem (the >= 500 uW device target class).
sections.2_existing_limitation: Existing transcutaneous power approaches (inductive coupling, battery, wired) trade depth/alignment sensitivity against device volume and revision surgery; per-cutaneous leads carry infection risk. No documented 940 nm GaAs photovoltaic transcranial power-delivery architecture was found in the closest prior art (PatentBear specific-mechanism query: 0 hits; closest reference lacks all 5 mapped elements — see NOVELTY_ASSESSMENT.json).
sections.3_proposed_technology: An implanted GaAs photovoltaic receiver (shipped geometry: 7 mm cell on substrate under hermetic encapsulation) powered by an external 940 nm near-infrared source through the tissue path, delivering electrical power to the implanted device function.
sections.4_mechanism: Optical chain: source -> Beer-Lambert tissue transmission I(d) = I0*exp(-mu_eff*d) (mu_eff 1.0-2.5 /cm at 940 nm, Jacques 2013) -> PV-surface fluence -> GaAs photovoltaic conversion -> conditioned electrical power (EQ-1/EQ-2/EQ-3 in the frozen equation registry). The complete stage-by-stage chain with every loss and evidence class is assembled in ENERGY_BUDGET.json — including its explicit UNKNOWNs and two recorded arithmetic discrepancies (D1: claimed ~1050 uW not reproducible from recorded inputs, ~121 uW derivable; D2: 500 uW target implies 4.3x more receiver area than shipped).
sections.5_evidence: 3 governing equations; 9 design inputs; 6 failure modes; parametric CAD shipped and VALID (receiver area grown 19.635 -> 38.485 mm², KEEP, measured on built solid); tissue-optics simulation chain PRE-REGISTERED (R309: MCX vs PyTissueOptics vs Jacques 2013) and asserted executed (fluence 1.0-1.4 mW/cm², MC agreement 0.11 %) — with the execution artifacts ABSENT from the repository (the claim self-labels MODELLED, independent_verification 'none'); all traceability chains honestly UNKNOWN; zero physical observation; unit error in the original power target (mW vs uW) caught and corrected by the external consultant review.
